name: g1-full-envelope
description: T11a / ENG-62 — the full G1 gate envelope over real QUIC: 64 x 32 x 64 m of real, resident, walkable terrain (not just isolated structures), a hollow tower/bridge spanning brick boundaries, an excavatable ramp, and a moving hollow test-volume body. The hollow test volume is added to SimWorld at scene construction, bypassing the commit pipeline (same as g4-workload's debris), so both clients are deliberately --late-join to pull the real T17 baseline (terrain + the body) instead of installing the fixed compile-time scene -- the only path whose world_hash agrees with the server's (see t23-g4-workload.json's note). Client 0 severs the tower, detaching the bridge; client 1 digs into the ramp. Passes only if both cuts commit, server/client hashes agree, and the committed topology-event stream replays from the tick-0 baseline to the same hash.
